label: Habits & Daily Routine
source: owner corpus content/rules.json (frozen); decisions index-joined to corpus rule order

added.text: Clear the clutter before you begin serious work. Disorder in the space becomes disorder in the mind.
added.source_figure: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, Gustave Flaubert

added.text: Maximize natural light in the spaces where you live and work. Light is not decoration; it is a variable that governs your energy.
Protect your workspace from noise intrusion. Chronic background noise degrades focus and elevates stress.
Give every object in your home a fixed place. Time spent searching is a tax on everything else you do.
Design your workspace around the demands of your work. The space you work in shapes the quality of what you produce.
